# Planetary Comms
Wolfgate's pull drags space-time around every world in the sector. Below orbit that drag smears the phase of ordinary radio until nothing can lock onto it. A [bold]mass transceiver[/bold] gets around this by riding a world's signals on a mass-modulated carrier, which the drag doesn't scramble.
## When a world is dark
A world is [color=#3fe05a]up[/color] while any mass transceiver on it, from the caverns to orbit, has power and is in one piece. Otherwise it is [color=#ff3030]dark[/color]:
- Headsets, intercoms and other radios on it can't send or hear. Talking into one says [italic]No signal[/italic]. - Announcements from off-world don't reach anyone on it, and a global announcement can't leave it. - The world's own PAs and station announcements still work, since they're wired. - A ship in orbit counts as on the world.
The [bold]crew channel[/bold] and [bold]handheld radios[/bold] work either way.
## Keeping it running
- The transceiver draws 3 kW from the nearest APC. Cut the power, or hit it with an EMP, and the world goes dark. - Enough damage from gunfire or explosions wrecks it. - To fix a wreck: add [bold]5 steel sheets[/bold], use a [bold]screwdriver[/bold], then a [bold]welder[/bold]. It comes back working, but still needs power.
